items.title: Renata to book the painters
items.quote: If the inspector signs off on Wednesday, I'll book the painters.
items.note: Conditional: speculative. 'on Wednesday' is when the inspector signs off, not when the painters are booked: no date. 0.30 + 0.05 = 0.35, Also noticed. A model that dates it Nov 4 gets a date error.

items.note: Conditional on the permit, no date: 0.30 + 0.05 = 0.35, Also noticed.
